caption: V-sweep × multi-seed (Rashmi 2026-06-10): steady-gen total DnaA (bulk+bound) min-max per dnaA-synthesis V. NO constitutive V keeps the WHOLE oscillation within [300,800] — low V (0.5-0.7e-3) brings the peaks under 800 but the troughs drop below 300 (122-208); high V (0.8e-3+) lifts the troughs but the peaks overshoot (1035-1450). The per-cycle amplitude (~3-4x peak/trough, from DnaA accumulate-then-halve) exceeds the band's 2.67x range at EVERY V, robust across 2 seeds. This is the V-tension: a constant synthesis rate structurally cannot fit the oscillation in the band -> autoregulation (dnaa-4), which dampens the amplitude via feedback, is required.
